Game Overview

At its heart, Noob and Pro Monster School is a two-player game about escape relentless monsters in Noob and Pro Monster School, where teamwork is key to survival. Navigate perilous levels with a friend, collect diamonds, and find the portal to progress. With each step, monsters grow faster, making strategic coordination vital in this thrilling, cooperative adventure.
